title: Scheduler + cycle-worker wiring
goal: Wire the interval-driven scheduler to the ported AutomatedCycleService, the durable cycle store, and every adapter, producing the actual unattended 20-minute loop.
steps: Implement a dependency-free setInterval/unref'd loop reading intervalMs from the operator state file (default 1,200,000ms)
Check the pause flag before starting any new cycle-triggering call; let an in-flight cycle finish its current stage before halting on pause
Acquire the exclusive lease before calling AutomatedCycleService.runOnce()/.recoverActiveCycle()
Wire liveMode: false -> true as a single explicit config flag checked by the signer service on every request, never inferred
Add an integration test proving a full dry-run cycle (real read-only probes + fixture-signed mutations) completes end to end
acceptance: Pause blocks the next cycle from starting; resume continues an interrupted one
An interval change takes effect on the next tick
A full dry-run cycle (real read-only probes + fixture-signed mutations) completes end to end
liveMode never flips without an explicit config write
notes: The actual autonomous loop the owner asked for. Must stay in dry-run mode (WP-25's script confirms preconditions) until ADR-0021 is signed. R4/money-safety-critical: per AGENTS.md, this package needs a fresh-context independent reviewer before merge — do not self-approve.
